# puddle fork patch stack: how .github/puddle/replay.py rebuilds the `puddle` branch on a new
# upstream release (fork-only file). Every commit on `puddle` since its upstream base must match one
# rule; an unmatched commit stops the replay, so a new fix gets a line here when it lands.
#
# Columns, separated by " | ":
#   action    pick     cherry-pick the commit; dropped when it comes out empty (upstream has it)
#             krun     regenerate: msb_krun pin + [patch.crates-io] to TijsVK/libkrun (libkrun leg)
#             russh    regenerate: [patch.crates-io] russh to TijsVK/russh (russh leg)
#             version  regenerate as the last commit: workspace version and `=` pins become
#                      <release>-puddle.N; the commit's other files (not Cargo.*) are kept
#             rm:PATH  delete PATH again on the new base (commit message kept)
#   match     the commit subject; a trailing * matches a prefix. First matching line wins.
#   folder    puddle's upstream-issues/ folder (the D-45 filing list), or -
#   upstream  owner/repo#N of the upstream PR once filed, or -. A merged PR whose merge commit is
#             in the new release drops the commit.
#
# action  | match                                                                   | folder                                  | upstream
krun      | build: use the puddle libkrun fork*                                     | -                                       | -
pick      | fix(runtime): drop a late bulk finish for a retired flow                | msb-relay-cross-lane-merge              | -
pick      | fix(ssh): report refused forwards as connect failed                     | msb-ssh-forward-connect-failed          | -
pick      | fix(ssh): report SFTP exit status so scp exits 0                        | msb-ssh-sftp-exit-status                | -
pick      | fix(ssh): don't report signal-killed commands as success                | msb-ssh-signal-exit-status              | -
pick      | fix(sandbox): remove storage of a rejected create                       | msb-stale-dir-on-failed-create          | -
pick      | fix(vsock): write queued guest bytes before closing a named-pipe route  | msb-vsock-close-tail-loss               | -
pick      | fix(runtime): forward a bulk terminal that no finish will follow        | msb-forward-reset-no-close              | -
pick      | feat(image): add a proxy option to the registry client                  | msb-registry-proxy-option               | -
pick      | fix(runtime): give the Windows bootstrap root the unix mountpoints      | msb-windows-bootstrap-root-dev          | -
pick      | fix(runtime): give a bind rootfs a /dev before the guest boots          | msb-bind-rootfs-dev                     | -
pick      | fix(runtime): raise the per-client forward limit from 64 to 256         | msb-forward-cap-retry                   | -
pick      | fix(ssh): retry a forward refused for the per-client limit              | msb-forward-cap-retry                   | -
pick      | fix(runtime): rotate runtime.log on Windows like on Unix                | msb-windows-log-rotation                | -
pick      | test(runtime): size the log files by path in the rotation test          | msb-windows-log-rotation                | -
pick      | test(runtime): show the child's stderr when the rotation test fails     | msb-windows-log-rotation                | -
pick      | fix(runtime): report a failed log rotation, keep writing and retry it   | msb-windows-log-rotation                | -
pick      | fix(image): retry transient registry failures and report a failed token request | msb-registry-transient-retry | -
pick      | fix(sdk): start the sandbox process in a session and console of its own | msb-console-isolation | -
pick      | fix(image): write the ext4 journal when an image is created             | msb-guest-fsync-latency                 | -
version   | build: version the puddle fork as*                                      | -                                       | -
rm:.github/workflows/release.yml | ci(puddle): drop upstream's release workflow from the fork branch | -                  | -
pick      | ci(puddle):*                                                            | -                                       | -
russh     | build: use the puddle russh fork*                                       | russh-peer-close-pending-data-wedge     | -
imago     | build: use the puddle imago fork*                                       | msb-guest-fsync-latency                 | -
